item.description:
Added

  • Calendar tab. A fifth tab showing the day as one wide timeline: hours run left to right, events sit in lanes as blocks sized by their real start and end, all-day events are chips up top, and a red line marks now with earlier hours dimmed. Scroll the day sideways with two fingers or a mouse wheel, step between days with the arrows, click an event to open it, and use the expand button to give overlapping events more room.
  • Mirror: an expand button. Hover the camera and press the corner button to enlarge it to a 420×236 preview across the whole row. The music player steps aside and the notch grows to fit; it resets when the mirror or the notch closes.
  • Option+1 to 5 switch tabs while the notch is open: Home, Shelf, Clipboard, Timer, Calendar. The keys are only claimed while a notch is open, and need no extra permission.

Changed

  • Tab icons sit a little closer together so five fit beside the notch.
